chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The worst of the nation will kill Al-Husayn, and whoever disbelieves in me will disown his progeny.'

key_terms.شَرُّ الْأُمَّةِ: The worst/most wicked of the nation

ai.seo_question: Who will kill Imam Al-Husayn according to the Prophet's prophecy?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores the centrality of Al-Husayn (a.s.) in Islamic eschatology, identifying his martyrdom as a defining event for the 'worst of the nation' (often interpreted as Yazid). It establishes a theological link between fidelity to the Prophet's progeny and true belief, implying that disowning Al-Husayn's lineage constitutes a denial of the Prophet's own legacy and authority.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-278 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.),
the Prophet (S) said, “The most wicked member of this nation will kill Al-Husayn (a.s.). Whoever denounces Al-Husayn’s (a.s.) progeny has denounced me.”
